## Status Quo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpcp)
library(tidyverse)
data(flea, package = "GGally")

flea_pcp <- flea |>
  pcp_select(species, 2:7, species) |>
  pcp_scale(method="uniminmax") |>
  pcp_arrange() 

flea_pcp |>
  ggplot(aes_pcp()) + 
    geom_pcp_axes() + 
    geom_pcp(aes(colour = species))



```
